# telnyx_email_inbox_sender_filters (Resource)

The sender allowlist and blocklist of an email inbox. Terraform manages both lists as a whole. The Telnyx API cannot delete them: destroy removes them from Terraform state and leaves them on the inbox.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "telnyx_email_inbox_sender_filters" "support" {
  inbox_id  = telnyx_email_inbox.support.id
  allowlist = ["partner.example.com"]
  blocklist = ["spam@example.net"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `inbox_id` (String) The inbox id.

### Optional

- `allowlist` (Set of String)
- `blocklist` (Set of String)

### Read-Only

- `record_type` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_email_inbox_sender_filters.example <inbox_id>
```
